newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales active at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales active at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active around midday, otherwise quiet, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with last Friday.
Inquiry was strong, demand light, except moderate near midday. Sales confirmed on 22,500 slaughter steers and 14,000 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date, 45,000 head confirmed including 5,800 head or about 13 percent prevously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs 68.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980-1150 lbs 68.00, couple pens 67.00-67.50.
Confirmed - 36,500 last week - none last year - 23,500
Wk to date - 45,000 last week - 8,800 last year - 37,100
